# `admin/patterns/commerce`

Admin screens present orders, invoices, carts, fulfilment and loyalty.

## Selection

- **Use when:** Admin screens present orders, invoices, carts, fulfilment and loyalty.
- **Avoid when:** The record is a catalogue product, whose options and readiness live in features/products.
- **Consider instead:** `features/products`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { AddressCard } from "themelia-ui/admin/patterns/commerce"
import "themelia-ui/admin/patterns/commerce.css"
```

## Composition

This family composes `base/action-menu`, `base/avatar`, `base/badge`, `base/buttons`, `base/choice-inputs`, `base/copyable`, `base/display`, `base/feedback`, `base/forms`, `base/item`, `base/navigation`, `base/structure`, `base/table`, `base/text-inputs`, `base/timeline`, `base/typography`, `base/value-inputs`, `patterns/timelines`.

Application policy—routing, fetching, persistence, permissions, and translation—stays
outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.

### `CodeEntry`

Kind: callable.

```text
({ kind, appliedCode, appliedDiscount, balance, error, loading, onApply, onRemove, strings, className, ...props }: CodeEntryProps) => import("react").JSX.Element
```

### `CodeEntryKind`

Kind: type.

CodeEntry — a discount code or a gift card.

These were two components, and they were the same component twice: a title, a field, a
button, and an applied state. The only real difference is that a gift card holds a
BALANCE — money that may outlast this order — where a discount either applies or does
not. That is one optional prop, not a second component.

`kind` picks the preset: the icon, the default copy, and whether the code is upper-cased
on submit. Gift card codes are printed in capitals and nobody types them that way.

```text
"discount" | "gift"
```

### `CodeEntryProps`

Kind: interface.

Extends: `Omit<ComponentProps<typeof ContentBlock>, "children" | "onSubmit">`.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `kind` | no | `CodeEntryKind` |  |
| `appliedCode` | no | `string` | The code in force. Present switches the card to its applied state. |
| `appliedDiscount` | no | `string` | What it took off, already formatted. |
| `balance` | no | `string` | What is left on the card, already formatted. Gift cards only. |
| `error` | no | `string` | A rejection message, shown under the field. |
| `loading` | no | `boolean` |  |
| `onApply` | no | `(code: string) => void` |  |
| `onRemove` | no | `() => void` |  |
| `strings` | no | `Partial<CodeEntryStrings>` |  |

### `CodeEntryStrings`

Kind: interface.

Copy for `CodeEntry`, which serves both a discount code and a gift card.

Two presets rather than two components: the wording differs because redeeming a gift
card is a balance lookup before it is an application, but the interaction is identical.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `title` | yes | `string` |  |
| `helperText` | no | `string` | Under the title. Empty for the discount case, which needs no explaining. |
| `fieldLabel` | yes | `string` | The field shows no visible label, so this is its only accessible name. |
| `placeholder` | yes | `string` |  |
| `apply` | yes | `string` |  |
| `remove` | yes | `string` |  |
| `applied` | yes | `string` |  |
| `balance` | yes | `string` | What is left on a gift card. Unused by the discount preset. |

### `SeoCheckId`

Kind: type.

Scores a listing's search presentation. Pure functions, so a draft can be scored while
typing. Weights: title 30, description 30, permalink 15, slug 10, origin 10, and keyword

```text
"title" | "description" | "permalink" | "slug" | "url" | "keyword"
```

| `amount` | yes | `string` | The magnitude, already formatted. The sign comes from the kind. |
| `processedAt` | yes | `string` | Already formatted. |
| `method` | no | `string` | How it was taken — "Visa ending 4417", "PayPal". |
| `reference` | no | `string` | The gateway's own id. Mono: it is compared and copied, not read. |
| `gateway` | no | `string` |  |

### `TRANSACTION_STATUS_TONE`

Kind: const.

```text
Record<TransactionStatus, BadgeTone>
```

### `TransactionKind`

Kind: type.

What was attempted against the payment method.

```text
"authorization" | "capture" | "sale" | "refund" | "void" | "chargeback"
```

### `TransactionStatus`

Kind: type.

Whether it worked.

```text
"success" | "pending" | "failure"
```

### `TransactionStrings`

Kind: interface.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `title` | yes | `string` |  |
| `kind` | yes | `Record<"authorization" \| "capture" \| "sale" \| "refund" \| "void" \| "chargeback", string>` |  |
| `status` | yes | `Record<"success" \| "pending" \| "failure", string>` |  |
| `reference` | yes | `string` |  |
| `empty` | yes | `string` |  |

### `UpcomingBookings`

Kind: callable.

```text
({ bookings, boxedDate, className, ...props }: UpcomingBookingsProps) => import("react").JSX.Element
```

### `UpcomingBookingsProps`

Kind: interface.

Extends: `Omit<ComponentProps<"div">, "children">`.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `bookings` | yes | `Booking[]` | Soonest first. This does not sort them — the order shown is the order given. |
| `boxedDate` | no | `boolean` | Draws each date as a compact rounded tile. Appointment times stay beside the service. |

### `VendorMetric`

Kind: interface.

An operating fact — lead time, fill rate, disputes.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `id` | no | `string` |  |
| `label` | yes | `ReactNode` |  |
| `value` | yes | `ReactNode` |  |

### `VendorProfile`

Kind: callable.

```text
({ name, initials, avatarUrl, role, verified, earnings, metrics, stats, view, onViewChange, onMessage, onHire, strings, className, ...props }: VendorProfileProps) => import("react").JSX.Element
```

### `VendorProfileProps`

Kind: interface.

Extends: `Omit<ComponentProps<typeof ContentBlock>, "children" | "title" | "role">`.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `name` | yes | `string` |  |
| `initials` | no | `string` | Derived from `name` when omitted. |
| `avatarUrl` | no | `string` |  |
| `role` | no | `ReactNode` | Category, market, location — whatever places them. |
| `verified` | no | `boolean` |  |
| `earnings` | no | `string` | Already formatted, including its currency. |
| `metrics` | no | `VendorMetric[]` |  |
| `stats` | no | `VendorStat[]` |  |
| `view` | no | `VendorView` | Controlled. |
| `onViewChange` | no | `(view: VendorView) => void` |  |
| `onMessage` | no | `() => void` |  |
| `onHire` | no | `() => void` |  |
| `strings` | no | `Partial<VendorStrings>` |  |

### `VendorStat`

Kind: interface.

A performance tile. `change` is a comparison, and its tone is stated, not inferred.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `id` | no | `string` |  |
| `label` | yes | `ReactNode` |  |
| `value` | yes | `ReactNode` |  |
| `change` | no | `ReactNode` |  |
| `changeTone` | no | `"secondary" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "destructive"` |  |

### `VendorStrings`

Kind: interface.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `tabOverview` | yes | `string` |  |
| `tabStats` | yes | `string` |  |
| `totalEarnings` | yes | `string` |  |
| `message` | yes | `string` |  |
| `hire` | yes | `string` |  |
| `verified` | yes | `string` | Names the tick, which otherwise states the fact by shape alone. |

### `VendorView`

Kind: type.

```text
"overview" | "stats"
```
